body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M\), every \(x\in\mathcal X\), and all real \(s,t\), \(F_x(s,t)=\widehat f_x(s+t)\phi_1(s)\phi_2(t)\) and \(G_x(s,t)=\widehat q_x(s+t)\phi_1(s)\phi_2(t)\).
body.justification: This is the observable two-channel factorization on which injectivity and inference rest.
body.gap: Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy analyze only the first identity; the marked identity is absent from their model.
body.consumer: The empirical characteristic-function confidence set uses these residual equations jointly.
